name: pl_backup_per_table
description: Backup per-table refresh: 45 tables in linear topological chain. Each activity = 1 table calling usp_RefreshCuratedTableFromView or usp_IncrementalTableLoad. Sequence: Forecast Silver W00→W03 → Forecast Gold W01→W30 → Inventory Silver W00→W02 → Inventory Gold W01→W30.
order: Forecast Silver W02: ActualDemandMonthly, ActualDemandWeekly, InvoiceWeekly, ForecastDemandMonthly, OpenOrderMonthly
Forecast Gold W01: Shared_DW (3 tables: DimCalendar, DimProduct, DimWarehouse)
Forecast Gold W10: ForecastAccuracy_DW dims (DimCustomerGrouping, DimForecastHorizon)
Forecast Gold W30: ForecastAccuracy_DW facts (FactForecastActual, FactForecastKpi)
Inventory Silver W00: InventoryHistory_Enh seeds (InventorySnapshotWeekly, AtpWeekEnding)

Inventory Silver W01: PurchaseOrderSnapshotHistorical, ManufacturingOrderSnapshotDaily(INC), HoldingTransferSnapshotDaily(INC), ForecastSnapshotWeekly, SupplyPlanDetail, ItemBalanceHistorical_WithInTransit, SafetyStockHelper, InvoiceDetailLineLevel
Inventory Silver W02: AFIStatusSnapshotWeekly, AwdHelper, LastInvoiceWeekly, Cogs52WWeekly
Inventory Gold W01: Shared_DW (3 tables, deduped from Forecast)
